scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run desktop:build
scripts.operator:ownership:verify: tsc -p tsconfig.operator-ownership-verification.json && node .tmp-operator-ownership-verification/scripts/verify-operator-ownership.js && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp-operator-ownership-verification', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.operator-understanding:verify: tsc -p tsconfig.operator-understanding-verification.json && node .tmp-operator-understanding-verification/scripts/verify-operator-understanding-contracts.js && node .tmp-operator-understanding-verification/scripts/verify-operator-understanding-lifecycle.js && node .tmp-operator-understanding-verification/scripts/verify-operator-understanding-services.js && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp-operator-understanding-verification', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.operator-intelligence:persistence:verify: tsc -p tsconfig.operator-intelligence-persistence-verification.json && node .tmp-operator-intelligence-persistence-verification/scripts/verify-operator-intelligence-persistence.js && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp-operator-intelligence-persistence-verification', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.operator-intelligence:authority:verify: tsc -p tsconfig.operator-intelligence-authority-verification.json && node .tmp-operator-intelligence-authority-verification/scripts/verify-operator-intelligence-authority.js && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp-operator-intelligence-authority-verification', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.operator-intelligence:trust:verify: tsc -p tsconfig.operator-intelligence-trust-verification.json && node .tmp-operator-intelligence-trust-verification/scripts/verify-operator-intelligence-trust-contracts.js && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp-operator-intelligence-trust-verification', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.guidance:verify: tsc -p tsconfig.guidance-verification.json && node .tmp-guidance-verification/scripts/verify-companion-guidance-contracts.js && node .tmp-guidance-verification/scripts/verify-companion-guidance-service.js && node .tmp-guidance-verification/scripts/verify-call-of-duty-guidance-provider.js && node .tmp-guidance-verification/scripts/verify-companion-guidance-application.js && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp-guidance-verification', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.native:build:discovery: dotnet publish desktop-native/Oracle.WindowDiscovery/Oracle.WindowDiscovery.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false --output dist-native
scripts.native:build:observer: dotnet publish desktop-native/Oracle.WindowObserver/Oracle.WindowObserver.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false --output dist-native
scripts.native:build: npm run native:build:discovery && npm run native:build:observer
scripts.desktop:build: npm run native:build && npm run desktop:compile
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build && concurrently -k "next dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/oracle && electron ."
